declare @strKey nvarchar(3000) IF @data = 0 BEGIN set @ma_hogiadinh = '' END set @strKey = 'ma_hogiadinh = ''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLParam(@ma_hogiadinh) + ''''
exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkhupho c on a.ma_khupho = c.ma_khupho left join dmphuongxa d on a.ma_phuongxa = d.ma_phuongxa left join dmttp e on a.ma_ttp = e.ma_ttp', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_khupho, d.ten_phuongxa, e.ten_ttp', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 50, @@admin, @@userId
